title: Pork, Potato Confit, and Garlic Pasta Recipe
description: This video provides detailed instructions for preparing a savory dish featuring citrus-marinated pork, confit potatoes, and a simple garlic oil pasta. It walks viewers through the steps for marinating the pork, confiting the potatoes, and finishing the pork with a pan sauce.
summary: The video outlines the preparation for a multi-component meal. First, the instructions detail preparing the pork, involving peeling the seeds, cutting the skin into wedges, and marinating them in juice from a naval orange. Next, corn is prepared and sliced and confited in a pan, layering potatoes with oil and salt, and cooking them slowly until tender. The video then focuses on searing the pork, which involves scraping the pan for fond, adding the pork back, and simmering until cooked through, with suggestions to enhance the sauce using palm sugar and lime juice. Finally, the recipe concludes with instructions for making a garlic oil pasta, starting with bucatini or spaghetti cooked in salted water and tossed with olive oil and garlic in a cold pan.
